= 2.9.87 =
* Frontend SEO and structured-data sections now close with the exact comment: <!-- end of SEO data Powered by PublishRank -->.

= 2.9.86 =
* Frontend HTML provenance comments now start with “SEO Powered by PublishRank” and close generated SEO sections with “Data generated by PublishRank”.

= 2.9.85 =
* Fix Assistant: retain the saved meta description when the editor meta panel has not mounted or synchronized yet.
* Image alt assistant: prefill missing article-image alt text from the latest Media Library alt value before using caption or filename suggestions, and clarify that publishers can edit and override the value.

= 2.9.84 =
* Breadcrumbs: added separate controls for the visible frontend trail and BreadcrumbList SEO/schema output. You can hide the trail on the site while keeping structured data enabled.

= 2.9.83 =
* Fixed administrator dashboard cards opening WordPress's generic "Sorry, you are not allowed to access this page" screen. Registered PublishRank submenu pages are no longer removed after registration, so direct dashboard links and the full submenu remain available.
* Retained and validated the breadcrumb separator symbol list, visible styles, and shared visible/schema breadcrumb trail.

= 2.9.82 =
* Breadcrumbs: choose the separator symbol from a list (arrow, angle, slash, pipe, dot, bullet, and more, or your own), pick a look (Plain, Chips, Bar, Underline) and size, and set optional text, link and background colours.
* Breadcrumbs: the visible trail and the BreadcrumbList structured data now come from one shared trail, so they always match (Google requires markup to describe a trail visitors can see).
* Breadcrumbs: new placement setting — Automatic (above the post title in block themes, above the content in classic themes), Above the content, Theme hook, Manual, or Structured data only. Added a "PublishRank Breadcrumbs" block, the publishrank_breadcrumbs() template tag, and a first-crumb label option.
* Breadcrumbs: added theme-neutral styling (no more numbered list), RTL-aware separators, category/tag/taxonomy/post-type archive trails, primary-category support, and the current crumb now uses the post title instead of the document title ("Title | Site").
* Breadcrumbs: a trail with fewer than two items is no longer printed or emitted as schema, and the WebPage node only references a BreadcrumbList that is actually output.
* Fix assistant: "Apply description" no longer reports "Enter a value first" — the apply handler now reads the field it belongs to.
* Fix assistant: Fix buttons now also cover focus keyword in the title (SEO headline), focus keyword in the opening paragraph (insert-as-first-paragraph), keyword missing from the meta description, title width and orphan pages; blocks always render with placeholders so there is somewhere to type.
* Fix assistant: every image without alt text (including images with no alt attribute) gets an alt field; saving writes the alt into the editor content as well as the media library, so the score updates.
* Fix assistant: applied SEO values are also pushed into the block editor's post state so pressing Update does not write the old value back; text typed into the assistant survives live re-analysis.

= 2.9.81 =
* Refined Newsroom cards, workflow stages, calendar events, and priority colors to use PublishRank's plum, evergreen, brass, coral, and warm ivory palette.
* Moved Newsroom into the PublishRank submenu directly after Dashboard and renamed the menu item to "Newsroom".
* Placed Site Verification immediately beneath Newsroom in the PublishRank submenu.
* Loaded the shared PublishRank palette and admin styles on Newsroom screens.

= 2.9.80 =
* Integrated the standalone Umarjaum Newsroom editorial workflow as the built-in PublishRank Newsroom module.
* Added newsroom stories, workflow stages, reporter/editor assignment, planning board, calendar, private collaboration, attachment handling, activity history, role controls, reminders, CSV export, and WordPress draft handoff to the PublishRank package.
* Preserved the newsroom's existing option keys and story metadata for compatibility with the standalone module; branded the admin menu and toolbar shortcut as PublishRank Newsroom.
* Updated the integrated module's asset paths and activation/deactivation lifecycle to run through PublishRank.

= 2.9.79 =
* Expanded built-in WP Hide Login to route dashboard scripts through the configured slug, including admin.php, index.php, AJAX and assets, while keeping the login page at /slug/.
* Added direct /wp-admin/ and /wp-login.php 404 handling, Apache rewrite-rule verification, a safe fallback when .htaccess changes cannot be confirmed, and migration-safe rule refreshes.
* Improved generated admin redirects and settings links; retired old slug rewrite rules when the configured slug changes.
* Reused WordPress core login handling and added an admin warning when the host cannot confirm the required Apache rules. Live-host and shared-host compatibility still require staging tests.

= 2.9.77 =
* Added an optional built-in WP Hide Login module with a configurable custom login slug, administrator settings page, nonce/capability checks, rewrite-rule handling, and generated login URL rewriting.
* Reuses the WordPress core login controller rather than replacing authentication logic; documented that custom login URLs are not a substitute for layered security.

= 2.9.76 =
* Corrected the settings/readme attribution disclosure: technical provenance markers are always on, but the plugin does not insert a visible footer credit or promotional link.
* Updated and expanded release regression checks for package metadata, local sitemap assets, removed remote News feed code, and nonce-protected admin handlers.
* Prepared a clean WordPress.org submission ZIP with the 2.9.76 version and current stable tag.

= 2.9.75 =
* Removed the optional live News feed (remote announcements.json request) and its admin screen, prompt, styles and script; the plugin no longer requests remote announcement data or remote images.
* Removed WordPress.org directory asset files (icons, banners, social images) from the plugin package; they are uploaded separately through SVN.
* The sitemap stylesheet (XSL) now embeds the bundled sitemap CSS and JavaScript from the plugin's own local files instead of linking them.
* Added explicit nonce and capability verification inside every handler that reads submitted data, including the Netlify account-link callback state.

= 2.9.74 =
* Sitemap stylesheet (XSL) no longer prints inline style/script blocks; its CSS and JavaScript are served from bundled assets/css/sitemap.css and assets/js/sitemap.js.
* Sanitized all remaining $_POST, $_GET, $_REQUEST, $_COOKIE, $_SERVER and $_FILES reads at the point of use (AdminAccess, TrafficGuard, redirects, 404 monitor, import, Baidu, post meta, local SEO, onboarding, live blog, internal links, authentication and Search Console forms).
* Verification files are filtered through a strict tag allow-list before saving and when served, and are output with wp_kses().
* Escaped output late for the editor score ring, live bar, verification meta tags, schema-type dropdown and JSON-LD (JSON-LD no longer uses JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES).

= 2.9.73 =
* Losslessly optimized the large publisher banner, social-sharing image, and two animated WordPress directory icons while preserving exact decoded pixels, format, dimensions, 24-frame timing, and looping.
* Reduced the combined size of the 20 shipped PNG/GIF assets from 4,083,704 to 3,948,728 bytes (134,976 bytes, 3.31%); no remote assets or image services were introduced.
* Kept tiny Composer development-vendor SVG report icons unchanged; they are not runtime plugin assets and are excluded from the WordPress ZIP. The bundled Font Awesome vendor directory contains only CSS/fonts, not image files.
* Synchronized plugin header, runtime version constant, and WordPress.org stable tag to 2.9.73.

* Kept native admin URLs and plugin pages unchanged for signed-in users; preserved the requested admin subpage after login and left recovery, registration, logout, AJAX, REST, cron and admin-post flows available.

= 2.9.65 =

* Replaced the path-based entry alias with a query-key login shortcut, preventing collisions with existing WordPress pages and permalinks. Updated Settings to state that this shortcut is not an access-control boundary.

= 2.9.64 =

* Replaced the redirect add action with an explicit submit button and made the PublishRank toolbar submenu open consistently on hover and keyboard focus.

= 2.9.55 =
* Fixed technical source provenance not appearing when a theme omits `wp_head()` or when SEO metadata was already present. The fallback now injects the always-on provenance markers independently of metadata/schema recovery and avoids duplicates. Added regression tests for themes missing wp_head() and for pages where SEO metadata already exists.
* Added guarded shutdown cleanup for PublishRank-owned frontend fallback output buffers; cleanup only flushes the matching topmost PublishRank buffer and does not close another plugin's buffer.
* Added direct-web-access guards to all standalone regression tests and corrected the stale source-provenance test fixture and Branding fallback version.
* Synchronized first-party runtime CSS with reviewable source copies and restored the onboarding quick-start styles used by the current onboarding markup.

= 2.9.53 =

= 2.9.52 =
* Added a responsive activation welcome screen with a quick-start guide and clearer legal disclosure for optional public attribution.
* Improved PublishRank toolbar and dashboard menu alignment across desktop, folded-sidebar and mobile admin layouts; shipped a white icon treatment for dark WordPress chrome.

= 2.9.51 =
* New: Site Verification page, first entry of the PublishRank menu. Verify ownership with Google Search Console, Bing, Yandex, Baidu, Naver, Seznam, Pinterest and Facebook domain meta tags, any other tag through a safe free-form box, or verification files (google….html, BingSiteAuth.xml and similar) uploaded or pasted in the page and served from the site root without FTP; a real copy is also written to the web root when it is writable.
* Pasting a complete <meta> tag now works everywhere (previously the tag was stripped to garbage). Tags pasted in the wrong field are moved to the right engine.
* Live check fetches the home page and each file the way a crawler does and reports Live, Warning (another plugin prints a conflicting value) or Problem, with the reason. Common page caches are purged on save. Tags are printed early in <head> with a last-resort injector for themes that omit wp_head().
* Integrity baseline build bumped (r5) so adding the new files does not raise a false tamper warning.
* New one-click "Sign in with Google" for Search Console through the PublishRank sign-in service (Supabase Edge Function): site owners no longer create or paste a Google OAuth client ID/secret. Refresh tokens and the OAuth client secret stay on the service; the site keeps only a revocable connection. A connection is issued only when the Google account has a Search Console property for the requesting domain.
* Property is matched to the site automatically; data syncs on connect.
* Live data layer: hourly background sync plus Heartbeat (15 s) updates for clicks, impressions, 48-hour hourly chart, top queries and pages, Google Discover and Google News totals, and a newsroom feed (published today, article SEO scores, IndexNow queue, 404 count). Live status bar under every PublishRank header. REST: GET /publishrank/v1/live, POST /publishrank/v1/live/refresh (administrators only).
* Search Console data now includes provisional current-day numbers (dataState all) so newsroom changes appear sooner.
* Publisher Account: Continue with Google is primary; other providers are shown only if enabled on the Supabase project.
* Replaced duplicate dashboard action lists with seven direct-action workspace cards, including Traffic Guard, with no nested action menus.
* Added opt-in local IP/CIDR block and allow rules plus trusted-proxy Cloudflare country rules. Invalid/untrusted geo headers fail open; admin, recovery, API and sitemap routes are exempt; Traffic Guard stores no visitor IPs.
* Admin palette refreshed to warm paper, deep plum, evergreen and brass; the dashboard hero artwork and active PublishRank menu highlight now match. Bundled Font Awesome Free 7.3.1 assets include their license.
* Disconnect revokes Google access and removes the service-side connection.
* Advanced: own Google OAuth client is still supported and takes precedence when saved.
* Live Preview in the post editor (block and classic): search snippet with pixel and character meters, Facebook and X cards, every meta tag, the exact JSON-LD (syntax-highlighted, copyable, with a Rich Results Test link) and a checks list. It is built from your unsaved edits by the same code that outputs the page, nothing is saved by previewing, and it refreshes as you type. REST: POST /publishrank/v1/preview/{id} (users who can edit the post).
* Fixed: the article score card now reads the real SEO title, description and focus keyword fields and the block-editor title.
* Fixed: JSON-LD identifiers could mix http and https on sites behind a proxy that does not forward HTTPS, leaving references unresolved. The configured scheme is now kept.
* XML sitemaps: styled index and child pages gain a type switcher, and Topics and Authors now carry a lastmod in the index.
* robots.txt: new SEO-tool crawler group (Ahrefs, Semrush, Majestic, Moz, DataForSEO, BLEXBot, PetalBot) with a one-click preset, optional WordPress housekeeping rules (xmlrpc.php, wp-login.php, ?author= enumeration, REST users list, comment feeds), WooCommerce cart and account rules, and protected paths that keep AI crawlers out of paywalled or members-only areas. Per-crawler groups now repeat the low-value and tracking rules instead of silently dropping them. Each section carries its own explanatory comment.
* llms.txt: password-protected and noindex posts are never listed; About, Contact, Editorial policy, Corrections, Ethics, Team and Privacy pages are detected and listed first; authors, tags, custom post types and a machine-readable resources section (sitemaps, news sitemap, robots.txt, RSS) were added; archives move under the Optional section defined by the format; descriptions use the PublishRank meta description and carry the publish date. llms-full.txt now has per-article metadata (date, update, author, section), authority pages first, a per-article word cap, a clean header and no empty summary line. Both files are cached until content changes and answer conditional requests (ETag, Last-Modified, 304). The settings screen shows a preview with a review of common mistakes (physical file in the web root, credentials in text, size, robots.txt conflicts).

= 2.9.50 =
* Added publisher schema types: ReportageNewsArticle, AnalysisNewsArticle, OpinionNewsArticle, BackgroundNewsArticle, ReviewNewsArticle, SatireNewsArticle, AskPublicNewsArticle and BlogPosting, plus FAQPage, AboutPage, ContactPage, CollectionPage, AudioObject and PodcastEpisode.
* Schema type is now selectable per post, page, category, tag and other taxonomy term (edit screen), plus site-wide defaults for category, tag, other archives, author pages and search results (PublishRank > Schema). FAQ Page takes questions and answers in the schema box and falls back to a standard web page when none are complete, so an empty FAQPage is never published.
* Public attribution is optional and disabled by default. No promotional HTML comment, link or footer credit is forced into public pages; administrators can opt in to version/fingerprint markers or a visible footer credit in Settings.
* Removed the forced head-comment module and its theme-recovery path; the SEO fallback now restores only missing metadata and JSON-LD. Generated sitemap audits verify child references against enabled providers and report duplicate URLs. Expanded live diagnostics to validate actual JSON-LD and check the sitemap index and up to ten same-origin child sitemap endpoints, including News Sitemap date freshness.
* Documented Google OAuth/Search Console, Supabase Auth, IndexNow and Baidu outbound data and official terms/privacy links; corrected the inaccurate external-link-check description.
* Added linear-gradient styling to the dashboard, settings screens and XML sitemap viewer. Public publisher pages are not styled by PublishRank.
* Robustness: schema and head output are now fail-safe (a PHP error while building them can no longer break the public page); the integrity baseline rebuilds automatically so this update does not trigger a false tamper warning; fixed the stale 2.9.49 fallback version string.
* Made Standard WebPage the explicit default schema for pages and made it selectable in the page editor.
* Added automatic ImageObject nodes for singular pages and posts with safe image fallbacks.
* Added multiple organization alternate-name variants and expanded PublishRank dashboard/toolbar shortcuts.
* Fixed dashboard welcome contrast and SEO score ring typography.

= 2.9.49 =
* Synchronized the package version metadata across the plugin header, runtime constant, readme stable tag and release checks.
* Removed the standalone local integration harness that invoked shell_exec and hard-coded localhost; it is not required for normal plugin operation.

= 2.9.48 =
* Maintenance release for the corrected news-publisher schema and breadcrumb output.
* Updated WordPress.org submission metadata and release version consistency.

= 2.9.47 =
* Normalize legacy Report/Review schema metadata to supported Article or NewsArticle output.
* Harden breadcrumb labels and ListItem positions when publisher or canonical data is incomplete.
* Keep the public source repository documented for WordPress.org review.

= 2.9.46 =
* Fixed the blank white XML sitemap page: the sitemap stylesheet request ended in a PHP fatal error ("Cannot use output buffering in output buffering display handlers"), so the browser had nothing to render. The head-recovery fallback no longer opens an output buffer inside a buffer callback; it renders at shutdown instead.
* Fixed the same fatal error blanking every front-end page whenever PublishRank's head output was off or missing, which also removed all JSON-LD from those pages.
* The sitemap stylesheet now has the same stale-rewrite-rule safety net as the sitemap XML, discards stray output before the XML declaration and is served as text/xsl.
* Every front-end document now gets a WebPage-family schema node: author archives output ProfilePage, search results SearchResultsPage, 404 pages WebPage, and the "Homepage webpage type" setting is honored on blog-style home pages (previously always CollectionPage).
* Fixed "Run graph scan": the follow-up auto-continue script threw "form.submit is not a function" (WordPress names the button "submit"), leaving the scan stuck at 0% until "Continue graph scan" was clicked by hand.
* Fixed the Graph settings form, which printed settings_fields() and so posted action=update instead of its own admin-post action.
* The content graph and image/video sitemaps now include pages (pages are public but not publicly_queryable, so they were silently excluded).
* Fixed persistent JSON-LD output for themes that omit wp_head() by adding a safe head-injection fallback.
* Fixed internal-link graph statistics by preserving edges after each scan.
* Added automatic external-link nofollow with explicit approved-domain exceptions; the primary domain and all subdomains remain followable.
* Hardened schema output checks for NewsArticle, Article, page overrides and related schema entities.

PublishRank changelog

2.9.44
- Consolidated and hardened the real-time article SEO analyzer.
- Added TinyMCE, Gutenberg, and Classic Editor content extraction with debounced updates.
- Fixed score-card and analysis-panel synchronization and supported editorial post-type checks.
- Fixed PublishRank toolbar icon/label and sidebar icon alignment.
- Retained the expanded schema registry and type-specific schema handling.
- Corrected the root GPLv2-or-later license notice and attributed project rights to Muhammad Umar Jabbar.

2.9.43
- See docs/RELEASE-2.9.43.md for the prior sitemap and schema release notes.

Implementation provenance: PublishRank's publisher toolkit is a custom implementation; it contains No Rank Math source code.

2.9.56
- Preserved the existing Live Preview SERP and connected schema graph systems.
- Added validated Facebook publisher Page and per-author profile attribution.
- Added optional cached, non-destructive social-share image watermarking with position, opacity, size and margin controls.

2.9.57
- Fixed real-time SERP preview field serialization for unsaved SEO metadata.
- Improved Gutenberg content/meta change detection and reduced preview debounce latency.
- Added reliable retry and manual refresh behavior without page reloads.

2.9.58
- Added a visitor-facing Website View to Live Preview for visible heading, summary, URL, social image, and schema consistency.
- Added advanced GitHub README documentation.
